20261119-chemistry-m1.topic: N'okpomọkụ edoziri, a mụbara nrụgide nke

20261119-chemistry-m1.material: N'okpomọkụ edoziri, a mụbara nrụgide nke gas nke oke ya bụ 60 mL na 1 atm ruo 3 atm. Kedu oke gas a dị dịka iwu Boyle?
20261119-chemistry-m1.thinking.0: N'okpomọkụ edoziri, a mụbara nrụgide nke
20261119-chemistry-m1.s.s1.prompt: N'okpomọkụ edoziri, a mụbara nrụgide nke gas nke oke ya bụ 60 mL na 1 atm ruo 3 atm. Kedu oke gas a dị dịka iwu Boyle?
20261119-chemistry-m1.s.s1.explain: Dịka iwu Boyle, mgbe okpomọkụ dị otu, $P_1 V_1 = P_2 V_2$ na-adị. $1\text{ atm} \times 60\text{ mL} = 3\text{ atm} \times V_2 \implies V_2 = 20\text{ mL}$.

20261122-chemistry-m1-1.material: [Ọsọ mgbasa miri emi] E tinyere owu a gbanyere na ammonia mmiri siri ike (molecular mass 17) na owu a gbanyere na hydrochloric acid siri ike (molecular mass 36.5) n'otu oge n'ọnụ abụọ nke ogologo ọkpọkọ gilaasị ma kpuchie ha na rọba. Nwa oge ka e mesịrị, mgbe eriri anwụrụ ọcha (ammonium chloride) pụtara n'ime ọkpọkọ, kedu ebe ọ dị nso?

20261122-chemistry-m1-1.s.s1.explain: Ọsọ mgbasa nke gas bụ inverse nke square root nke molecular mass. 20261119-chemistry-m2.material: Kedu nkọwa banyere nhazi 'ion', ebe atom neutral na-efunahụ ma ọ bụ nweta electron wee nwee charge, ziri ezi?
20261119-chemistry-m2.s.s1.prompt: Kedu nkọwa banyere nhazi 'ion', ebe atom neutral na-efunahụ ma ọ bụ nweta electron wee nwee charge, ziri ezi?

20261119-chemistry-m2.s.s1.hint.1: Chlorine (Cl) na-enweta otu electron ma ghọọ Cl⁻.
20261119-chemistry-m2.s.s1.o.o0: Atom metal na-efunahụ electron ma na-aghọ (+) ion ngwa ngwa, ma atom non-metal na-enweta electron ma na-aghọ (-) ion ngwa ngwa

20261119-chemistry-m2.s.s1.o.o2: Mgbe e funahụrụ electron, ọ na-aghọ anion nwere (-) charge

20261121-chemistry-m2-1.title: Mgbe e tinyere ihe nlele A

20261121-chemistry-m2-1.goal: Apply principles of Mgbe e tinyere ihe nlele A to solve the reasoning problem.
20261121-chemistry-m2-1.material: Mgbe e tinyere ihe nlele A na B amaghị n'ime ọkụ n'èzí, ihe nlele A gosiri ọkụ ọbara ọbara odo, ma ihe nlele B gosiri ọkụ acha anụnụ anụnụ akwụkwọ ndụ. Kedu metal dị na ihe nlele A na B?
20261121-chemistry-m2-1.thinking.0: Mgbe e tinyere ihe nlele A
20261121-chemistry-m2-1.s.s1.prompt: Mgbe e tinyere ihe nlele A na B amaghị n'ime ọkụ n'èzí, ihe nlele A gosiri ọkụ ọbara ọbara odo, ma ihe nlele B gosiri ọkụ acha anụnụ anụnụ akwụkwọ ndụ. Kedu metal dị na ihe nlele A na B?
20261121-chemistry-m2-1.s.s1.explain: Ihe metal ụfọdụ na-egosi agba ọkụ pụrụ iche. Sodium ($\text{Na}$) na-egosi ọkụ odo, copper ($\text{Cu}$) na-egosi ọkụ acha anụnụ anụnụ akwụkwọ ndụ.
20261121-chemistry-m2-1.s.s1.hint.0: Agba ọkụ nke sodium dị n'ime nnu bụ odo odo ọcha.

20261121-chemistry-m2-2.material: Kedu reagent a ga-awụsa iji nyochaa ma chloride ion (Cl⁻) nke fọdụrụ dịka ihe sitere na ịkwụsị ọrịa dị n'ime mmiri ọkpọkọ, na kedu formula nke precipitate ọcha e mepụtara?
